Batch: JoeWare PSOMgr, QLogOff and Quiet publisher source review

Scope.AdFindAcceptance: Excluded from selected acceptance batches; no AdFind action in this review.

Findings: PSOMgr manages Active Directory Fine-Grained Password Policy Password Settings Objects and domain password policy; page version 1.00.00 dated 2007-04-15.
Publisher historical platforms are Windows 2000, Server 2003, XP, Vista and Longhorn-era AD; no current Windows support is established.
Full changes require Domain Admin or relaxed PSO permissions; domain-policy modifications require Domain Admin. Source code is unavailable.

Sources.Finding: The tool supports view, add, modify, rename, delete, multi-delete, quickstart, and assignment changes. Mutations require -forreal; some multi-delete paths can include assigned policies with an override. No directory endpoint was contacted.

Findings: QLogOff immediately logs off the user without save prompts; page version 1.00.0 dated 2001-01-28.
Publisher historical platforms end at Windows XP; permission to log off is required and source code is unavailable.
Quiet starts a process without a taskbar window; the process remains visible to process enumeration and is killed on logoff; page version 1.01.00 dated 2002-04-27.
Publisher historical platforms end at Windows XP; no special security requirement is listed and source code is unavailable.
